record_title: Exact FGM thresholds and entropy defects for blockwise copula substitution
provenance: SCOPE Phase II scientific record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: The sharp threshold is for a bivariate FGM outer copula with one m-dimensional independence-product block. The general operator criterion assumes smoothness and does not cover arbitrary multiblock substitution. The entropy bound is not claimed optimal. Older linkage and prescribed-multivariate-marginal literature remains a residual originality risk; originality is to the best of our knowledge.
